sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.supportedMechanism: Causal mask, scaled dot-product attention, feed-forward/residual and positional mechanisms.
sources.limits: Authored one-head pre-RMS/tanh decoder variant, not the original post-norm ReLU encoder–decoder.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
sources.supportedMechanism: RMS normalization by the root mean square of features.
sources.limits: Teaching implementation fixes gain to one and adds epsilon 1e-5 inside the root; epsilon limits exact scale invariance.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: PyTorch autograd mechanics
sources.locator: How autograd encodes the history; saved tensors
sources.supportedMechanism: Reverse-mode graph, saved intermediate values and accumulation of derivatives.
sources.limits: Independent scalar TypeScript tape; no PyTorch runtime or performance equivalence.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: PyTorch Adam algorithm
sources.supportedMechanism: First/second moments, bias correction and parameter update.
sources.limits: Beta1=.9, beta2=.999, epsilon=1e-8, no weight decay, global clipping before moments; constant learning rate.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: TRL SFTTrainer
sources.locator: Label shifting and masking; assistant_only_loss and completion_only_loss
sources.supportedMechanism: Shifted labels and masking prompt positions while supervising response positions.
sources.limits: Fixed one-turn symbol dialogue; no production chat template, packing implementation or TRL execution.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization
sources.supportedMechanism: Pairwise chosen/rejected response log-ratios relative to frozen reference and logistic loss.
sources.limits: Authored swap preference pairs, answer plus EOS sequence scores; not human preference collection or general alignment evidence.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

sources.title: PyTorch probability distributions
sources.supportedMechanism: Sampled action, log probability and negative reward-weighted log-probability surrogate.
sources.limits: Two-action contextual bandit. Detached exact reward baseline and exact categorical KL are stated derived additions; no PPO, GRPO or long-horizon credit assignment.
recheckTriggers: New mechanism or empirical claim added

reviewDisposition.unitsAndDenominators: Reviewed token/pair/rollout denominators; binary64 payload excludes overhead; tape nodes are not FLOPs.
reviewDisposition.modelAssumptions: Reviewed fixed dimensions, authored corpus conflict, train-only gradients, constant learning-rate schedule, objective and parameterization boundaries.
reviewDisposition.claimQualifiers: Toy task computations only; no vendor timing, general capability, human-learning or safety claim.
reviewDisposition.dependencyAndVisualScope: Pure modules and UI read actual model state. Full browser/device/accessibility interaction is an integration gate.

freshnessWorkflow: Recheck affected primary sections and numerical tests after equation, objective, tokenizer, data or checkpoint changes; append dated review evidence without overwriting previous events.
